title: Contact Classification
one_line: Classify contacts by department, seniority and role from their job title, and route them to the right persona.
description: Classify contacts by department, seniority and role from their job title, and route them to the right persona. Use when a contact list has messy titles, when routing by persona, or when deciding who in a company to actually contact.
paragraph: Job titles are unstandardized across companies and countries, and title matching by keyword sends the wrong message to the wrong person at scale. This skill classifies to department and seniority rather than matching strings, handles the ambiguous titles explicitly, and routes each contact to a persona with a stated confidence.
keywords: who should i contact at this company

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: contact-classifier 0.003 USD per contact.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
